verdict.rationale: New Relic is documented only as a hosted SaaS platform, and the evidence shows no way to run a local or dev instance of it. A community user says development mode was removed, and another is looking for an alternative that can run locally. The perpetual free tier is a hosted account, and `nr1 nerdpack:serve` serves only custom UI Nerdpacks for testing, so both are adjacent features rather than a local instance of the platform.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a local or dev instance of the platform to test instrumentation and dashboards
